validity_notes: VN-1 [DECISIVE GATE FAILURE]: prereg.md#11 V3 requires that reconstruction recover a path for every admitted item (n_misses==0) and states explicitly that 'Any missing item -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID listing the misses (representation loss, not a negative)'. n_misses=29. Per decision-rule gate G1, a V1-V6 failure yields status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE. This disposition was fixed by the frozen design BEFORE any revalidation cost was observed; it is a pre-registered representation-loss catch, not a post-hoc judgement, and it is not a scientific negative.

VN-2 [WHAT THIS IS NOT]: This packet does NOT show that full-path persistence fails to beat cold re-derivation. It contains no revalidation cost, no change rate, no dead rate, no naive-replay false-accept rate and no frozen decide() outcome. Nothing here may be read as support for or against C-CROSSSITE maintenance economics.

VN-3 [MOST LIKELY CAUSE, NOT ESTABLISHED]: The miss pattern is consistent with live-site restructuring since the frozen BFS frame was captured: the 26 docs.pytest.org misses are all per-release changelog pages under /en/stable/announce/, and the 3 doc.rust-lang.org misses are book-chapter and reference pages from a restructured edition. This diagnosis is a hypothesis about cause, NOT a measured observation; the frozen design did not authorise fetching the missing URLs individually to distinguish 'page removed' from 'page no longer linked within depth 6 of the frozen seed'. n_misses is the measured quantity and it alone triggers V3.

VN-4 [SECOND, INDEPENDENT BLOCKER - HARNESS ENVELOPE]: even with an intact frame the frozen design could not have completed in this run. The frozen module sleeps the nominal ladder 300+900+1800 = 3000 s before and between revalidation windows, and must additionally issue roughly 926 reconstruction GETs + ~931 snapshot GETs + 4x~931 revalidation GETs at observed single-host latencies of 0.1-0.3 s. The minimum wall clock is therefore >= 3558 s (about 59 minutes). The invoking harness .github/scripts/run-opencode-resilient.sh defaults SPIDER_MODEL_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS to 1200 s and, on expiry, issues kill -TERM then kill -KILL to the entire model process group (-$MODEL_PGID), and additionally reaps the model group after any parent exit specifically to stop orphan descendants. The frozen confirmatory measurement is therefore structurally unreachable inside one EXECUTE agent process. This is an infrastructure envelope mismatch, not a scientific negative, and it is the same mechanism behind the prior recorded EXECUTE failures (failure.json 'stage exited with code 67'; model_execute.json attempt 3 exit_code 124, category transient).

VN-5 [REPRESENTATION LOSS]: the population actually represented in run/raw/paths.jsonl is 179 of the 208 admitted deep items (86.06%), missing 3 on doc.rust-lang.org and 26 on docs.pytest.org. Any per-item cost computed on that subset is computed on a non-random subset of the frame and must never be compared against the frozen per-item threshold 4.006731, which is defined over the full 208-item admitted set. The subset path-length mean 4.402235 is recorded in metrics under an explicitly NON-DECISIONAL key for that reason and must not be thresholded.

VN-6 [DO NOT OVER-READ THE SUBSET MEAN]: it is tempting to note that the subset mean 4.402235 already exceeds the frozen per-item pay threshold 4.006731, which would point toward the pre-registered a-priori FALSIFIES branch of prereg.md#15. That comparison is INVALID and is not made here: the threshold is defined over 208 items, the subset is 179 items selected by exactly the variable under study (site survival), and no revalidation window was ever executed. Reporting it as a decision would be a preregistration weakening after seeing outcomes.

VN-7 [SUBSTRATE]: single runner vantage, credential-free, GET-only, stdlib urllib, no browser, no Docker, no credentials, no model calls, no pip installs. Results are not external-valid across ASN, geography or egress IP (inherited limitation from the parent program).

VN-8 [SESSION-SCALE BOUND NOT EXERCISED]: V7 forbids day-scale staleness or freshness-detector statements. No window was measured at all this run, so no change, dead or false-accept statistic exists at any horizon.

VN-9 [ORPHAN CONTAMINATION CONTROLLED]: see OBS-11. Two prior-attempt orphans were concurrently writing into this experiment's packet directory and were terminated during this attempt. No packet-directory raw/ or derived/ artifact from them exists, so no producer measurement in this packet is attributable to them. A future attempt should verify no orphaned execute_module process is live before starting.

VN-10 [FROZEN INPUT INTEGRITY]: every freeze.json.hashes entry (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md, design_review.json) and every freeze.json.artifact_hashes entry (9 files) was re-hashed at the start of this attempt and matched. No frozen file was modified. The parent handoff sha256 ffcd914d5f1ed0447fd239b6e723fc39b73bcc4e8b13b6b468d980414e90d6d6 matched. The only file written inside the packet directory by this attempt is execute_module.py (the frozen V1 reconstruction of the prereg block, which prereg.md#9 names as the EXECUTE driver) and the run/ evidence directory.
unresolved: U-1: Whether the persistence-maintenance economics question is answerable at all on this frame. The frozen 20-host/556-item frame was captured before the live sites restructured; 29 of 208 admitted deep items are no longer reconstructible under the frozen policy. A re-census is required before any re-run of this question.

U-2: For each of the 29 misses, whether the page is gone (HTTP 404) or merely no longer linked within depth 6 of the frozen seed. The frozen design contains no arm that distinguishes these, so the cause is unresolved.

U-3: The four outcome-bearing quantities remain entirely unmeasured: revalidation GETs, revalidation bytes, elapsed revalidation time, and the session-scale change/dead/false-accept rates (M-REVAL-PATH-GETS, M-REVAL-UNIQUE-GETS, M-REVAL-PATH-BYTES, M-REVAL-PATH-ELAPSED, M-CHANGE-RATE, M-DEAD-RATE, M-FALSE-ACCEPT-NAIVE are all null).
